title: tiniaria × heterocarpa
intro: Tiniaria × heterocarpa, commonly known as Bearberry, is a low-growing, deciduous shrub native to North America. It is used in herbal medicine to support urinary health, particularly in cases of urinary tract infections and incontinence, due to its diuretic and astringent properties. The health benefits of Bearberry include its ability to relieve symptoms such as frequent urination, burning sensations, and discomfort. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including arbutin, which is a glycoside that has been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
